quote:
Momentum used to mean scale.
Now it means how quickly you move from data to decision.

@synorb streams now connect to any
@openbb_finance account in seconds.
No integrations. No onboarding drag. Just structured stories flowing straight into the tools professionals already rely on.

For teams in private equity, hedge funds, and banking, the distance between finding a signal and forming conviction is shrinking fast.
We are building the infrastructure behind that shift: the decision-speed layer for modern finance.

Our focus is not on more data. It is on better stories for machines — filings, letters, research, posts, podcasts, and more — organized for real-world reasoning, not human view counts.

Explore the library. Tell us what resonates, what is missing, and what needs more depth.
We are building this with the people who move markets, and we want your perspective shaping it.

The next infrastructure layer in finance is being built where distribution meets reasoning.
It’s early, but the shift is already visible.
The firms that master this layer will define how quickly capital learns, adapts, and compounds.

Help us build the streams your systems and your decisions deserve.
author: @bshivarthy

quote:
I was on BloombergTV recently. 😉

What excites me most is hearing Parag bring this conversation into the open.

At @synorb, it is grounding to know we are part of a growing community thinking about the future in similar ways. Like the phenomenal team at Parallel, we believe streamlining the durable web is critical.

We also believe this is only the starting point. The durable web is small, and the ad-driven internet built for human attention is best treated as a noisy prior. The opportunity ahead is to create vast amounts of original content designed to inform our language model powered machines.

This is not flashy work, but it is foundational. It is how we will expand intelligence beyond the limits of human attention.

There is much still to build, but it no longer feels like we are building it alone.

quote:
There is huge value in enabling language models to reason with numbers like they do so masterfully with words.

Lots of approaches being experimented with by super smart people around the world.

In the meantime, at @synorb we are pursuing an alternative approach.

One that works right now for a majority of real-world human questions and one that leans into the strengths of language models rather than delve into managing its liabilities.

It’s all about telling stories to our machines. Reach out if you are interested to learn more.
